decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated several Bluetooth speakers across different price points and use cases. My consideration set included high-end home speakers, rugged outdoor options, and popular budget choices. The Sony SRS-RA3000 stood out because it offers 360 Reality Audio and Wi-Fi connectivity in addition to Bluetooth, making it much more versatile for high-quality home listening than the cheaper, portable-focused options. While the EDUPLINK and comiso models are well-rated for their price, the Sony brand reputation and unique spatial audio technology justified the premium cost for a stationary home speaker setup.
